SUBSTITUTE ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the C2-3,
Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District; C2-5, Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial
District; and T, Transportation District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 13-
G in the area bounded by:

a line 248.7 feet north of and parallel to West Argyle Street; the west right-of-way line of
the Paradise and Pacific Railroad; West Ainslie Street; the alley next west of and parallel
to North Broadway; West Argyle Street; and North Broadway,

to those of a C1-5, Neighborhood Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

nj/Manaa-Hoppenworth
Algerwoman, 48" Ward

Common Addresses:
4901-5043 N. Broadway
4900-4928 N. Broadway

ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the C2-3 Motor
Vehicle-Related Commercial District and C2-5 Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District
symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 13-G in the area bounded by:

      a line 248.7 feet north of and parallel to West Argyle Street; the west right-of-way line of
      the Paradise and Pacific Railroad; West Ainslie Street; the alley next west of and parallel
      to North Broadway Avenue; West Argyle Street; and North Broadway Avenue,

to those of a C1-5, Neighborhood Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                           ____________________________
                                                           Leni Manaa-Hoppenworth
                                                           Alderwoman, 48th Ward



Common Addresses:
4901-5043 N. Broadway Avenue
4900-4928 N. Broadway Avenue
